subject: phy-u-fund
title: PHY.U.FUND.------TR.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-34 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the diversion sequence syndrome … does in fact affirm an alternative vibration — or vibrational intention — and we are forced to look at how given considerations can be incorporated into the general reality of the society without actually changing the essence factor of the culture.' (C)PHY-U-FUND (the concept of physical-universe-fundamental) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what physical-universe-fundamental requires to produce transformation, when the establishment has the sophistication to absorb alternative considerations without essence-factor change. C-INFO (composite information) branches from the main line and leads to OBS (observation), which carries P-FC (particular focus). C-AF-ALGN (composite affinity alignment) also branches from the main line and leads to RE-ST (restructuralism), from which a second TR branches. TR appears twice in the diagram (once as the partner at the end of the main line, once at the end of the branch from RE-ST), registering that transformation is being marked at two levels — as conceptual partner and as actual interior structure.
